summary: This is an 8-K filed by Worthington Enterprises, Inc. reporting fiscal Q4 2026 results (Item 2.02) and the appointment of W. Bradley Southern to the board of directors (Item 5.02). The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. It is a routine current report on operations and a standard director appointment (non-abrupt, non-forced). No special-situation terms or mechanics are present.
